projection: First independent POST create-baseline HTTP operation plus all its original status/body assertions; same extracted source bytes in both variants. R full enclosing TestComplianceRoutes fails later unrelated ignore missing expectation.
setup_change: Original direct handler registration replaced by compliance route table assembled by actual production setupRouter; terminal handlers replayed into same auth-free router so original HTTP inputs/header/assertions remain unchanged. SettingVariable migration and SettingsService are ancillary setup dependencies.
semantic_caveat: This isolates actual production route topology, not authenticated end-to-end application request handling. A direct full-router substitution would require auth and env-proxy fixture changes and could fail on those before the target. Root and second reviewer must explicitly approve this operation-localization convention before counting.
strict_Def1: Even if matrix succeeds, original direct handler test bypasses bootstrap routing; classify Target Bypass unless actual Eff difference at c0 is independently established.
